info.description:
NOTE: payloads come from the run log, whose logger shortened every string value longer than 110 characters (offer ids, tokens, selection keys) to 100 characters + "...[truncated]". Structure and all other fields are complete, but those long values are NOT replayable; three folders (OW-BAS-01, RT-BAS-01, RT-BUN-02) have no payloads at all (see each folder description).

Evidence collection for the AirArabiaPlus / USA V2 booking-creation matrix (24 cases). One folder per flow, named `<TC id> | <CorrelationId>`; each folder holds the sequential endpoints with the recorded Request body and the recorded Response saved as an example. The folder variable `correlationId` is injected into the `CorrelationId` header of every request by the collection pre-request script. To EXECUTE the flows live (CorrelationId extracted from Search and chained automatically) use NDC_Integrations_Staging_V2_AirArabiaPlus.postman_collection.json with env AirArabiaPlus_USA_ne6.

exec: // Every request in a flow carries the same CorrelationId (folder variable = the id the flow was recorded with).
